QQQ.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance (unofficial provider client)

interpretation.text:
On 2026-11-06, QQQ’s 252-observation DFA H was 0.520, slightly above the ideal independent, finite-variance returns reference of 0.5. R²=0.980 describes fit quality only across supplied scales, 8–63 observations. H rose 0.0135/0.0445 over 1/5 observations. Its prior-only 30-estimate standardized deviation was +2.70; overlapping windows mean this is not a significance test.

Hill alpha was 3.300 over 1,000 observations, using k=100 and x_min=0.01990 absolute log-return units. Under a suitable tail model, lower estimates suggest heavier fitted absolute-return tails; higher estimates suggest thinner tails. The 5%/15% tail cutoffs yield 3.591/3.080: sensitivity, not a confidence interval.

From 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-06, H rose from approximately 0.500 to 0.520. Alpha moved 3.309→3.198→3.300 on November 4–6. Rolling-window entry/exit and threshold changes can affect alpha. These are uncertain descriptive estimates, not a crash forecast.
